description: Named look & feel presets for the universal card. Each key is a preset id (referenced from content as card-preset/{id}); each value holds the attributes written verbatim to the host element. Furniture tokens (chip/sticker/save/play) are appended by the renderer from card content.

stack.name: Stack Preset
stack.description: Default column card — media on top, 16:9

showcase.name: Showcase Preset
showcase.description: Column card with a taller 4:3 media frame — products, credentials

split.name: Split Preset
split.description: Media left, content right, content twice as wide

portrait.name: Portrait Preset
portrait.description: Square media beside content — reviews, small product shots

portrait-top.name: Portrait Top Preset
portrait-top.description: Square media anchored to the top of the frame — people

panel-accordion.name: Panel Accordion Preset
panel-accordion.description: Content-only card whose nested accordion is divided — FAQ-style lists

panel-accordion-boxed.name: Panel Accordion Boxed Preset
panel-accordion-boxed.description: Content-only card whose nested accordion is a bordered, rounded, divided box

stack-subtle.name: Stack Subtle Preset
stack-subtle.description: Column card on an off-white surface, large type — quotes

stack-brand.name: Stack Brand Preset
stack-brand.description: Column card on a dark surface — stats, pricing tiers, announcements

stack-accordion-divided.name: Stack Accordion Divided Preset
stack-accordion-divided.description: Column card whose nested accordion is divided — FAQ-style lists

stack-offer.name: Stack Offer Preset
stack-offer.description: Column card on a muted grey surface — membership and pricing offers

stack-accordion.name: Stack Accordion Preset
stack-accordion.description: Default column card whose nested accordion is a bordered, rounded, divided box

panel-subtle.name: Panel Subtle Preset
panel-subtle.description: Content-only, off-white surface, large type — quotes

panel-brand.name: Panel Brand Preset
panel-brand.description: Content-only on a dark surface — stats, pricing tiers (set --ui-card-dark-bg to the accent for a branded look)

panel-dark.name: Panel Dark Preset
panel-dark.description: Content-only on a dark surface — announcements, alerts

hero.name: Hero Preset
hero.description: Content overlaid bottom-left on a 4:3 frame with scrim — events, campaigns

poster.name: Poster Preset
poster.description: Tall 3:4 overlay card with scrim and a display-size headline — destinations, covers

media.name: Media Preset
media.description: Bare <ui-media> frame, no card chrome — hero images, banners, standalone visuals. rds() applies because the frame owns its own corners outside a card.

prose.name: Prose Preset
prose.description: Bare <ui-content> column, no card chrome — standalone text sections and full article views. text: body — the long-form body renders instead of the teaser summary (summary as fallback when no body exists).

carousel.name: Carousel Preset
carousel.description: Column card whose media items scroll-snap with dot navigation — galleries

flip.name: Flip Preset
flip.description: Reveal card: overlay front face, flip to a scrollable detail panel — from the ui/reveal flip demo

hero-reveal.name: Hero Reveal Preset
hero-reveal.description: Full-width reveal hero — expand on small containers, scale on large; dark panel — from the ui/reveal hero demo
